subject: Nimbus MAP: retention windows + SOC2/SIG redline sync
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbusfin.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.inference
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@nimbusfin.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP + retention ask (SOC2 / SIG / DPA)

Chloe – thanks for the call earlier. Attached is our initial mutual action plan (MAP) draft and a short summary of our security gates. High level asks from our side: 
- SOC 2 report (in-scope: Type II, last 12 months)
- Completed SIG/CAIQ with evidence pointers
- DPA with specific data retention windows and EU data residency options (we'll need a clause for 7y retention for transactional logs, 90d for user-generated content by default)

Can you confirm Redwood's support for the retention tiers above and whether you can add an EU residency option? Also please share the typical turnaround for SOC2 evidence intake (we'll need to schedule an evidence sprint).

Attachments: nimbus-MAP-draft-20270608.docx

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Product Operations Manager | Nimbus Financial
From: chloe.martin@redwood.inference
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbusfin.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.inference, marcus_lin@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + retention ask (SOC2 / SIG / DPA)

Elena — thanks for the MAP and the clear asks. Looping in Laura (legal) and Marcus (product/infra) to confirm DPA redlines and retention feasibility. Quick answers up front: 
- SOC 2: we can provide last 12 months Type II (report + SOC 2 bridge letter where applicable). Typical intake to evidence sprint kickoff is ~2 weeks from POA (we'll share a checklist).
- SIG/CAIQ: yes, we can provide completed CAIQ with evidence links; some items will reference ISO/SOC artifacts we host internally.
- Retention: Marcus — can you confirm support for 7y transactional logs and configurable 90/180/365d buckets for user content? Also please advise on EU residency options and any lead time for provisioning.

Samir — if you want to pre-share specific DPA redlines, Laura can take a first pass. Otherwise we can review the redline you attach.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync Thurs to walk the MAP and finalize the evidence sprint dates. Does 10:00am PT work for your team?

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.inference
To: chloe.martin@redwood.inference, Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbusfin.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.inference
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + retention ask (SOC2 / SIG / DPA)

Elena / Chloe — I reviewed the MAP and attached a preliminary DPA redline (dpa-redline-20270609.docx). High-level notes: 
- EU residency: we support EU-hosted private deployments for production plans; for Hosted API customers we offer an EU-region tenancy option (data at-rest EW/FR regions) but need a scoped addendum for guaranteed residency and backup controls.
- Retention: Redwood is willing to commit to configurable retention policies, including a 7-year retention for transactional logs, but we need explicit scope language for log types (e.g., auth logs, transaction audit trail) and an exception flow for legal holds. 
- DPA clause ask: please confirm whether Nimbus requires deletion verification certificate on retention expiry — we can provide deletion logs but not a formal signed certificate without an addendum.

I've flagged a few carveouts in the doc where we need Nimbus to confirm: encryption key ownership for on-prem keys, and escrow/KMS for EU-residency deployments.

Suggested next steps from legal side: 
1) Review our redline and mark must-haves vs negotiable items.
2) If Nimbus requires deletion verification, we'll propose an addendum scope and estimate.
3) Schedule evidence intake: I'll attach the SOC2 intake checklist after you confirm the sync.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwood.inference
To: chloe.martin@redwood.inference, Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbusfin.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.inference
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + retention ask (SOC2 / SIG / DPA)

Elena / team — quick infra feasibility notes: 
- Retention tiers: we already support per-customer retention config for user content with presets at 90/180/365 days. Adding a 7-year transactional log bucket is operationally feasible but will require a storage plan (estimated cost delta) and changes to the log ingestion pipeline for long-term archival. I can produce a rough cost delta in the next 48 hours.
- EU residency: for Hosted API customers we can deploy a region-scoped tenancy within 2-3 weeks once the plan is signed; provisioning private VPC/on-prem options takes longer (4-6 weeks) depending on networking and KMS arrangements.
- Evidence sprint: we have a runbook for SOC2 evidence intake; we can reserve an evidence sprint week starting Jun 21 if that aligns. The runbook includes a dedicated intake doc, SRE/infra owner list, and artifact links (I'll attach the SOC2 summary PDF).

I'll attach: redwood-soc2-summary-2027.pdf and will follow up with a cost estimate for the 7y bucket. Chloe — I can join Thurs 10:00am PT sync.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Director, Product Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
